description: Long-running daemon. Every 300s, queries via WriteService /query: SELECT id, candidate_name, candidate_url, candidate_description FROM mcp_discovery_candidates WHERE (promoted IS FALSE OR promoted IS NULL) AND (candidate_url LIKE '%npmjs.com/package/%' OR candidate_name LIKE 'npm/%' OR candidate_name LIKE 'io.modelcontextprotocol/%') LIMIT 50. For each candidate: extract npm package name (parse from candidate_url after /package/ or strip 'npm/' prefix from candidate_name); GET https://registry.npmjs.org/<pkg>/latest with 8s timeout, User-Agent 'zo-sentinel/1.0 (mcp-trust-intelligence)'; parse fields {name, version, description, homepage, repository.url, author, maintainers, time.created, time.modified, dist.tarball, dependencies}; mint server_id = hashlib.md5(('npm|' + pkg_name).encode()).hexdigest(); ws_query mcp_server_registry WHERE server_id = ? to skip if already present; otherwise ws_write mcp_server_registry with row {server_id, name=pkg_name, registry_source='npm', url=candidate_url or 'https://www.npmjs.com/package/'+pkg_name, description=npm_description[:1000], trust_score=0.0, verdict='unknown', verdict_reasoning='', confidence=0.0, last_assessed=null, first_seen=npm.time.created, last_seen=now, last_scanned=null, scan_count=0, risk_tier='unassessed', metadata=json.dumps({version, repository_url, author, maintainer_count, dependency_count, age_days})}; on success, ws_execute UPDATE mcp_discovery_candidates SET promoted=TRUE, reviewed_at=now() WHERE id=?. Heartbeat thread every 30s. Single-instance lockfile at /home/workspace/logs/candidate_npm_promoter.lock. NEVER imports duckdb or sqlite3. Uses requests + json + hashlib + threading + datetime only. Logs structured INFO line on each batch with promoted_count, npm_404_count, npm_error_count, skip_already_present_count. Respects an inter-fetch 250ms sleep to stay polite to npmjs.org. Logging: only logging.FileHandler(LOG_FILE), no StreamHandler (avoid double-line bug under nohup). Schema columns are LIVE-VERIFIED: mcp_discovery_candidates(id BIGINT, candidate_name, candidate_url, candidate_description, discovered_in_directory, discovered_status, first_seen, last_seen, reviewed_at, promoted), mcp_server_registry(server_id, name, registry_source, url, description, trust_score, verdict, verdict_reasoning, confidence, last_assessed, first_seen, last_seen, last_scanned, scan_count, risk_tier, metadata).
